thread:
incident-bot: PAGED: gen-service high error rate detected (sev: p1). 1200 errors in last 5m. Root route: /v1/generate. Escalating to oncall.

sarah (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a spike in 5xx from the fastgen pool in us-west-2. rolling a quick traffic reroute to fallback cluster now. will draft a status post once we have initial customer impact.

dennis (sre): Confirmed. Errors start at ~2623456000, ramp at 2623456500. Logs show `oome` and `kv-cache` miss spikes. Adding `--drop-kv-cache` flag on one host to test.

mike (prodeng): Do we have a broad customer impact? Any Dedicated tenants affected?

sarah (oncall): Preliminary: hosted API customers on shared pools affected, some streaming sessions failing to reconnect. Dedicated pools unaffected per telemetry. Estimating 10-20% of requests in us-west-2 degraded.

julie (comms): I'll stand by to copy-edit. Can you paste a short initial blurb I can publish to the status page and customers? Prefer two sentences + impact bullets.

sarah (oncall): Draft below — please edit.

```
Initial update (draft):
We are investigating increased 5xx errors impacting text and streaming generation in the us-west-2 region. Our on-call team has routed traffic away from the affected nodes and is working on remediation.

Impact:
- Hosted API: increased error rate and occasional dropped streams for requests routed to us-west-2.
- Dedicated: no impact.
- Mitigation: traffic reroute in progress, automated fallback to us-east-1 enabled.

Next update: 20 minutes or when we have new findings.
```

julie (comms): Nice start. Suggest we be explicit about customer-facing verbs and add ETA for next update. Edited suggestion: "We are investigating an increase in server errors affecting text generation and streaming in US West (us-west-2). We've rerouted traffic from the impacted pool and enabled automatic fallback to US East (us-east-1)." Add: "We expect to provide an update within 20 minutes."

dennis (sre): Quick note: fallback increases latency for some requests ~150ms. Might be good to call that out so customers know degradation vs outage.

sarah (oncall): Good call. New draft below — please sign off.

```
Statuspage candidate:
We are investigating increased server errors affecting text generation and streaming in US West (us-west-2). We have rerouted traffic away from the affected GPU pool and enabled automatic fallback to US East (us-east-1); customers may see increased latency (~150ms) or occasional failed streaming sessions. Dedicated capacity customers are not affected.

What we're doing:
- On-call is remediating the underlying host failures and performing cache warmups.
- Rolling additional nodes into the pool to restore capacity and avoid further throttling.

Next update: within 20 minutes or sooner if we have a resolution.
```

julie (comms): Approved from comms. I'll prepare the status page and customer email templates.

mike (prodeng): Ops checklist — before publish: confirm no in-flight DB migrations, validate quota enforcement not failing, ensure rate limits are temporarily increased for fallback. Sarah can you confirm?

sarah (oncall): Confirmed no migrations. Quotas look normal. Temporarily bumped fallback concurrency by 10%.

ops-bot: :memo: Draft posted to internal channel for review at 2623456805.

julie (comms): Publishing now to status page and sending to customers in the affected cohort (hosted API customers in us-west-2). Copy of notice: 

"We are investigating an increase in server errors impacting text generation in US West (us-west-2). We have rerouted traffic and enabled fallback to US East; some requests may see higher latency or occasional stream failures. We will provide an update within 20 minutes"

sarah (oncall): Published. Incident post id: SP-2026-319. Notifying account reps for impacted customers.

dennis (sre): Mitigation update at 2623456850: one host showed repeated KV cache thrash after hot restart. Evicted that host from the pool; traffic now stable on rerouted nodes. Error rate down from 1200/5m -> 120/5m.

julie (comms): Drafting second status update. Proposed language: "We have reduced error rates through traffic reroutes and host eviction; error volume has decreased significantly. We continue to monitor and are working to fully restore normal operation."

sarah (oncall): Good. Also add planned follow-up: ETA to full restore ~40 minutes, pending cache warmups and node roll.

julie (comms): Posted update. Customers notified of reduced impact and ETA.

mike (prodeng): Please keep an eye on increased tail latency during fallback. Might need a toggle if 95th p99 crosses threshold.

dennis (sre): Monitoring 95/99 now. p95 settled at +140ms, p99 at +420ms for a small subset — will flag if it breaches 500ms.

sarah (oncall): Resolved notice candidate (do not publish until final verification):

```
Resolved:
The issue causing increased server errors in US West (us-west-2) has been mitigated. We evicted an unhealthy host and restored capacity to the affected pool. Normal operation has resumed and error rates have returned to baseline. Dedicated capacity customers were not impacted.

If you continue to see errors, please open a support ticket or reach out to your account rep.
```

julie (comms): Hold for 10m to ensure stability, then I'll publish the resolved update + postmortem link when ready.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Monitoring: 15 minutes post-eviction shows stable metrics.

dennis (sre): Verified baseline for 30m in us-west-2 at last check (2623456890). Ready to close.

sarah (oncall): Publishing resolved notice now. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

incident-bot: Incident SP-2026-319 marked resolved by sarah (oncall) at 2623456899.

julie (comms): Published resolved status and queued postmortem draft for review (link in internal doc). Will send a short customer follow-up summarizing root cause and mitigation steps later today. :thumbsup:
